title: Exploring SENACE Datastreams & Offline Mode
text: Subdivided Web Views: portal interface, SENACE subdivides datasets interactive web browsing. example, Consultoras Ambientales split 10 separate pages (one per subsector like Mining, Electricity, Agriculture). contrast, REST API delivers complete master dataset single query (ConsultorasAmbientales). Filtered Project Views: portal displays separate cards Approved, Evaluation, Disapproved projects. API datastream CarteraProyectos returns projects across evaluation states. Web-Displays: web pages (Especialistas, Participación Ciudadana, Viáticos) static portal displays without exposed public API endpoints.

title: Getting Started with senaceR
text: senaceR package provides programmatic access open data published SENACE (Servicio Nacional de Certificación Ambiental para las Inversiones Sostenibles), national authority responsible evaluating detailed environmental impact assessments major investment projects Peru. REST API, SENACE exposes datasets covering environmental certification portfolios, registered consulting firms, institutional visits, public information requests, budget execution. senaceR simplifies data access : Handling API authentication (auth_key). Formatting JSON API responses tidy R tibble objects. Bundling local data snapshots offline work automatic fallback operation.

title: Programmatic Access to SENACE Open Data
text: Direct REST API Integration: Access SENACE’s live endpoints using personal API key (auth_key). Tidy Tabular Data: responses automatically formatted modern tibble objects. Offline & Fallback Mode: Includes pre-packaged, compressed local datasets (LazyData). live API unreachable, senaceR gracefully falls back bundled snapshots informative warning. what: Architecture: API Datastreams vs. Web Catalog
title: Programmatic Access to SENACE Open Data
text: SENACE Web Portal lists 22 items online catalog, official REST API consolidates 8 core Datastreams: Project Portfolio (3 web views → 1 API Datastream): portal breaks projects separate pages (Approved, Evaluation, Disapproved). API datastream CarteraProyectos returns projects single table. Consulting Firms (10 web views → 1 API Datastream): portal lists firms individual subsector (Agriculture, Mining, Energy, Transport, etc.). API datastream ConsultorasAmbientales consolidates registered firms across subsectors. Web-Views: Items Especialistas, Participación Ciudadana, Viáticos web-portal displays without dedicated public REST API endpoints.
